correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and parameters are explicit: existing GQ(q,q), q integer at least 2, real unweighted incidence graph, and canonical symmetric idempotents. The BFS layer and edge-rooted two-tree counts follow from degree q+1, diameter four and girth eight. Flux balance determines each radial Laplacian Green difference; these furnish exact signed potential and current levels on every edge. Summing absolute values gives Q=1+6q^4/H, C=8q^4/H; algebra proves reversal at q=3 and the strict 7/8 limits. The finite W(3,2) and W(3,3) exact rational Laplacian inverses check all 205 edge columns and every predicted diagonal/norm. No claim is made that finite verification establishes the general formula.

value.rationale: Exact endpoint complementability norms of canonical cut and cycle spaces are natural real Banach-space invariants related to localization of electrical flows. The full infinite GQ family, independence from edge transitivity, nontrivial cut/cycle dominance reversal at order three, and sharp asymptotic 7/8 suprema materially extend knowledge beyond general logarithmic localization bounds and the diameter-three symmetric block-design case. No unmotivated small-parameter slice or mere definition substitution is claimed.
